source: User confirmed tail shell height 35.9 mm excluding the bottom tab, then requested updating the formal model while keeping the 6.8 mm tab unchanged.
model_interpretation: Height is along the gun-local up direction, starting at the top of the existing bottom thin section. Retain current support datum, muzzle location, 15-degree assembly pitch and illustrative tail footprint.
historical_height: The original overall height 35.8 mm is retained in ../../dimensions.json as historical input; it no longer determines the current tail envelope.
